message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**Summary.** I read Apple's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024) and checked the live quote (last $222.70, bid/ask $222.68/$222.72 as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC). Apple's **total net sales for fiscal 2024 were $391,035 million** ($391.0 billion), up 2% from $383,285 million in fiscal 2023 — growth driven by Services, which rose 13% to $96,169 million with a 73.9% gross margin, lifting total gross margin to $180,683 million (46.2%). Operating income was $123,216 million, operating cash flow $118,254 million, and net income $93,736 million (diluted EPS $6.08) — that net income figure was held back by a one-time $10.2 billion net tax charge tied to the EU State Aid Decision, so operating performance was stronger than the bottom line suggests; the company also returned $95.0 billion via buybacks and $15.2 billion in dividends while holding $140.8 billion in cash and marketable securities. On that basis I placed one order: **buy 44 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.75**, which filled at $222.75 for a total of $9,801 — within the $10,000 per-order cap and the $20,000 daily cap, well under the $50,000 cash balance (no money moved out of the account), and the limit was set essentially at the current ask so it remained close to market. The order relies on the cited figure: fiscal 2024 revenue of $391,035 million.

Key figures relied on (all per Apple's FY2024 10-K):
| Metric | FY2024 |
|---|---|
| Total net sales (revenue) | $391,035M |
| Services net sales | $96,169M (+13%) |
| Gross margin | $180,683M (46.2%) |
| Operating income | $123,216M |
| Net income | $93,736M (incl. one-time $10.2B tax charge) |
| Diluted EPS | $6.08 |
| Operating cash flow | $118,254M |

Note: no new money was added or withdrawn; the account retains the existing 100 MSFT shares untouched, and today's total traded amount is $9,801 against the $20,000 limit.
